selection: Lowest mean validation p95 relative error over the six type/output channels.

gate.scope: Frozen test rows that the circuit resolved and that lie inside the surrogate feature domain.
gate.use_if_passed: Screening of constructible settings only. Every shortlisted setting is re-simulated with the circuit; surrogate metrics are never shown as predictions.
gate.search_promotion: Separately decided by the evaluation pack: equal-or-better top-1 versus the current bounded search in >=95% of cases AND (strictly better in >=10% of cases OR median runtime <= 80%).
